The explosive story of the biggest mistakes in US history – from White House insider turned host of hit podcast The Rest Is Politics: US , Anthony Scaramucci

We’re living in an age of deep political anger and frustration. Where did it come from, and how do we get out?

From Main Street to Wall Street, from the boardroom to the Situation Room, Anthony Scaramucci uncovers the true origins of America’s current crisis. He pinpoints the catastrophic decisions that dismantled the system supporting the American Dream –deepening inequality, corroding trust and ultimately empowering Trump’s ascent and assault on democracy.

Rising from the working class to the heights of finance and power, Scaramucci knows first-hand how money and ideals are intertwined. Now widely admired for his storytelling and blistering political analysis, he brings fresh perspective to how both parties betrayed those they once represented, cutting through partisanship and offering a roadmap for rebuilding opportunity, security and hope.

All the Wrong Moves is not about right and left. It’s about right and wrong.

This audio edition features a bonus, audio exclusive interview between Anthony Scaramucci and Dominic Sandbrook, co-host of The Rest is History.

‘Essential reading’ ALASTAIR CAMPBELL & RORY STEWART

‘This is the Mooch at his most thoughtful and wise’ EMILY MAITLIS

‘Irresistibly engaging, provocative and insightful’ DOMINIC SANDBROOK

‘Funny, fascinating and unsparing – Anthony's book is deliciously like Anthony. When is he EVER not totally compelling?’ MARINA HYDE

‘Told with great clarity and a sharp wit’ STANLEY TUCCI

‘Has the rare talent of offering important political insights while also being blisteringly funny’ ROBERT PESTON
